title: Sony BRAVIA 4K VH21 (XR-55A80K, 2022 OLED, device BRAVIA_VH21, MediaTek mt5895), EU firmware
notes:
Sony BRAVIA 4K VH21 (XR-55A80K, 2022 OLED, device BRAVIA_VH21, MediaTek mt5895), EU firmware
Android 12 (Google TV, API 31), build BRAVIA_VH21_EU-user 12 STT2.230505.001.S136 682241, 3 GB RAM

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/sony-bravia-4k-vh21-eu/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/sony-bravia-4k-vh21-eu/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Same device and build as sony-bravia-4k-vh21 (Australia); the EU firmware differs in its preloads
(ARD, All 4, ITV, My5, iPlayer launchers, YouView, HD+, YouTube Music: all already disabled at the factory
on this set, so not in this list) and has no AU broadcaster apps.
Stock launcher: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx (Google TV). build-and-install disables it.
Live TV / tuner app: com.sony.dtv.tvx. Keep the com.sony.dtv.tvinput.* services, tvapi, sonysystemservice,
sonyvendorservice, imeproxy, settingsprovider, systemupdate/update, braviasync* and all com.mediatek.*:
they drive HDMI, the tuner, the Input overlay, Bravia Sync, updates and the remote's app buttons.
Kept by owner's choice: Netflix, YouTube, Apple TV, Chromecast built-in (mediashell), AirPlay/HomeKit,
firmware updates, and Sony IP control (com.sony.dtv.webapi.core): Home Assistant's Sony Bravia integration
and other IP remotes need it; with it disabled HA reports the TV as off and every command fails.
interactivetvutil kept: it holds a TokenProvider other Sony apps may read.

Remote: the Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video and Disney+ buttons are routed by Sony's sonyvendorservice, not by
the Google TV launcher, so they keep working after launcherx is disabled. YouTube, Prime Video and Disney+
all arrive as keycode 196 (scancodes 485, 490, 491), so remapping one of them needs a scancode entry in
app_keys (scan:490:<package>) with HOME_KEY_SERVICE=1; a keycode remap (or a keycode-only remapper app)
takes all three. KEYCODE_SETTINGS does nothing once launcherx is off; HomeKeyService brings it back.
KEYCODE_TV_INPUT opens Sony's own input overlay, so INPUT_KEY_SERVICE is not needed here.

setupwraith owned the Wi-Fi network saved during first setup: forget and re-join it in Settings before
disabling setupwraith, or the TV drops off Wi-Fi. Other networks it still owns are deleted when it is disabled.
Reboot-checked: everything below stayed disabled. Applied 21 Oct 2026. If something breaks,
`pm enable <package>` and please report it.
